result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. Compilation succeeds, but I didn't run any tests.

In `getAllTeams` in `LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, I added `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` to the remainder condition. Dormant contributors that no team matches are now left out of that team. Configured teams are untouched and keep all their members. `isActive()` already treats a blank latest-commit date as active, so contributors with missing dates are not dropped.

When no teams are configured, `getAllTeams` returns every contributor before reaching this code, so that path is unchanged.
